name: Star Field
description: A quiet twinkling star field and an occasional shooting star, as two layers you can stack.

props.name: density
props.description: Stars per 100,000 square pixels, in three sizes.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: Let each star brighten and dim slowly at its own rate.

props.name: colors
props.description: The first colour is used for most stars; the second and third tint a few of them. At night the stars glow; on a light surface they are fine ink specks.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the layer, which is absolutely positioned to fill its nearest positioned parent. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: minDelay
props.description: Shortest pause between two shooting stars, in milliseconds.

props.name: maxDelay
props.description: Longest pause between two shooting stars, in milliseconds.

props.name: minSpeed
props.description: Slowest starting speed, in pixels per second. Each star decelerates as it fades.

props.name: maxSpeed
props.description: Fastest starting speed, in pixels per second.

props.name: angle
props.description: Range for the direction of travel in degrees, where 0 points right and 90 points down.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the bright head: near-white at night, ink on a light surface.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the layer, which is absolutely positioned to fill its nearest positioned parent. Other div props are passed through.
